top_signals.title: Spot bitcoin ETFs shed $1.8 billion in past week as outflows become ‘structural’: analysts
top_signals.summary: Risk-averse investors are moving further away from crypto products as they expect the another interest rate hike in December, analysts said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: 'Risk Is Still Here': How Asia Was Hit By Market Rout
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks were hit hard by the fallout from last week’s rout in the AI trade. Policymakers in China, South Korea and Taiwan have introduced support measures, and further action could provide a buffer against extreme market sentiment. Analysts share their views on Bloomberg TV. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Oil Prices Slide as AI Bubble Fears Rattle Global Markets
top_signals.summary: A stock selloff driven by doubts about the economic growth potential of artificial intelligence infected commodities, too, dragging crude oil prices down today despite continued tanker attacks in the Persian Gulf. At the time of writing, Brent crude was trading at $92.55 per barrel, with West Texas Intermediate at $83.45 per barrel. Both were down from the opening of trade in Asia, but they were both higher than their Friday close, suggesting the effect of the stock selloff was limited in energy commodities. top_signals.title: Japan Power Prices Extend Rise to Four-Year High on Cold Outlook
top_signals.summary: Japan’s spot electricity price rose to the highest in more than four years, as forecasts for cold and snowy weather in parts of the country make increased consumption of expensive gas more likely.
